3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Kesaro Kibener had convinced him to have a meeting with me just before the Court vote.

4.speaker: Heron Garaci
4.text: "Very nice location you've set up here, Mr. President."

5.speaker: Player
5.text: "Oh this place is not mine. It's Petr's."

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: It was yet another sunny day, and I was facing another important political figure: Heron Garaci.

17.speaker: Narrator

18.text: The bribe had worked and he agreed to have a meeting with me just before the Court vote.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: We scheduled to meet outside of Holsord, in my new vineyard in Erlory, where we could have some privacy.

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: We scheduled to meet outside of Holsord, in the Gentlemen's Club of Petr in Erlory, where we could have some privacy.

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: I grabbed a drink and sat down under the shadow of a red oak at the villa's garden overlooking the red grapevines.

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: I grabbed a drink and sat down on the balcony of the villa overlooking its vast garden.

23.speaker: Heron Garaci
23.text: "Very nice place you've got here, Mr. President."

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: He had reached out to us and wished for a meeting just ahead of the Court vote.
27.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Heron_SentKesaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Heron_SentLucian"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn07_HeronMeeting_OfferBribe"] == true) == false)

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: Heron sat next to me in his beige checked suit and took off his white trilby.

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: Heron sat next to me in his beige checked suit and took off his white trilby.

32.speaker: Player
32.text: "We thought this place would be fitting."

33.speaker: Player
33.text: "I don't set up meetings. My team chose this place."

34.speaker: Heron Garaci
34.text: "Didn't know the Vice President had such good taste."

36.speaker: Heron Garaci
36.text: "Please send my regards to your team then."

37.speaker: Player
37.text: "Oh I'm not. I just recently bought this place."

39.speaker: Player
39.text: "I like the calmness here. And the sight of the grapevines."

40.speaker: Heron Garaci
40.text: "Well, I'll be looking forward to have a taste of your wines."

41.speaker: Heron Garaci
41.text: "You're lucky to have such a place to come and relax."

46.speaker: Heron Garaci
46.text: "So, Mr. President... I wanted to talk to you for a couple of reasons."

47.speaker: Heron Garaci
47.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Faction_OldGuard_Content"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false)

51.speaker: Heron Garaci
51.text: "Your gesture of goodwill went a long way. Please do speak of your intentions and how I could I be of assistance to you."

52.speaker: Heron Garaci
52.text: "You went a long way to make this meeting possible. I had to pay you the respect."

53.speaker: Heron Garaci
53.text: "Please do speak of your intentions and how I could I be of assistance to you."

54.speaker: Player
54.text: "I want you and your buddies in the Court to pass the changes."

56.speaker: Player
56.text: "I'm waiting for your gesture of goodwill now."

57.speaker: Player
57.text: "We need your help with the upcoming vote."

58.speaker: Heron Garaci
58.text: "I believe I have already showed that by coming here. Behind the Chief Justice's back."

59.speaker: Heron Garaci
59.text: "You know I'm taking a risk here."

60.speaker: Heron Garaci
60.text: "I don't like to speculate. I want you to ask it yourself."

61.speaker: Heron Garaci
61.text: "Yes. Not an easy thing to make it happen."

63.speaker: Heron Garaci
63.text: "But I'm prepared to help with that."

64.speaker: Heron Garaci
64.text: "As long as we help each other."

65.speaker: Player
65.text: "Don't you dare opposing me after you accepted my money."

66.speaker: Player
66.text: "You know I'm taking a much higher risk here, Mr. Garaci."

67.speaker: Player
67.text: "Look. I need your help with the upcoming vote."

68.speaker: Player
68.text: "I'm not here to play your games."

69.speaker: Player
69.text: "Drop the act, Mr. Garaci. Let's not waste each other's time."

71.speaker: Heron Garaci
71.text: "I have not yet decided what to do."

72.speaker: Heron Garaci
72.text: "Perhaps you are right. You have already taken so much by getting involved in bribery."

73.speaker: Heron Garaci
73.text: "Let's not forget that you gave me evidence that could lead to a trial."

75.speaker: Heron Garaci
75.text: "I can help you beyond this vote."

76.speaker: Heron Garaci
76.text: "Wouldn't you want to have a Chief Justice who'd be sympathetic to your concerns. Doesn't it sound nice?"

78.speaker: Player
78.text: "I don't think you would be that person."

79.speaker: Player
79.text: "So you want to take Orso's place huh?"

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: He took a sip from his drink.

82.speaker: Heron Garaci
82.text: "First of all, I have to say that I'm behind your proposal. It is the position of the majority of the Sollist Justices."

83.speaker: Heron Garaci
83.text: "We didn't want to create unnecessary risks by talking to you directly until now."

85.speaker: Player
85.text: "So the Old Guard has actually decided to support me?"

86.speaker: Player
86.text: "I'll admit, it's a nice surprise to hear this from you."

87.speaker: Player
87.text: "Sounds too good to be true. I was told otherwise about your stance."

88.speaker: Heron Garaci
88.text: "We can't be open about this now, can we?"

89.speaker: Heron Garaci
89.text: "Some of us see no problem with your proposal."

91.speaker: Heron Garaci
91.text: "He is fanatically working to undermine you. I'm afraid that it has gone too far. There are plans of..."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: He coughed and took a sip from his drink.

93.speaker: Heron Garaci
93.text: "Well... He is organizing the Sollists against you. He has influence over a lot of people as you know, but he's now losing the Supreme Court's support."

94.speaker: Player
94.text: "You're right. It does sound rather nice."

99.speaker: Heron Garaci
99.text: "I would be. If you allow me."

101.speaker: Heron Garaci
101.text: "I already have a reasonable support behind me. If Orso is dismissed from the Court, I can take his place and keep helping you."

102.speaker: Heron Garaci
102.text: "We must think beyond the vote, Mr. President."

103.speaker: Heron Garaci
103.text: "If you promise me to go ahead with it, I can provide you with some evidence against him. If we pass your proposal, you can use it to impeach him."

104.speaker: Heron Garaci
104.text: "Promise me that you will dismiss him from the Supreme Court. And him only."

105.speaker: Heron Garaci
105.text: "And I will support you not only with the vote but afterwards."

106.speaker: Heron Garaci
106.text: "I thought you were the one who asked for my help, Mr. President."

107.speaker: Heron Garaci
107.text: "I gave you my offer. If you don't like it, there will be no support from my end. Easy as that."

109.speaker: Player
109.text: "I like the offer. It's a deal."

110.speaker: Player
110.text: "Are you positive the evidence can lead to his impeachment?"

111.speaker: Heron Garaci
111.text: "And I will support you not only with the vote but afterwards."

112.speaker: Player
112.text: "I believe there are more people who needs to go."

116.speaker: Player
116.text: "How about another investment, Mr. Garaci? I'm sure we can find an amount you'd like."

123.speaker: Player
123.text: "Fine. I like your offer. It's a deal."

124.speaker: Heron Garaci
124.text: "Great to have come to an understanding."

126.speaker: Player
126.text: "No. I can't promise you such a thing."

143.speaker: Player
143.text: "I'm sure this would convince you. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

144.speaker: Player
144.text: "You'd better rethink your position, Mr. Garaci. I could have you dusted off."

149.speaker: Player
149.text: "You'd better rethink your position, Mr. Garaci. I could have you thrown in the can."

151.speaker: Heron Garaci
151.text: "That was a clear death threat towards a Supreme Justice."

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: He put his hat back on.

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: He laughed and put his hat back on.

156.speaker: Heron Garaci
156.text: "It looks like we don't share a collaborative spirit."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: He put his hat back on and stood up.

165.speaker: Heron Garaci
165.text: "But I can now safely say that I will do my best to have your proposal pass the Court, Mr. President."

166.speaker: Heron Garaci
166.text: "Fine. I'll help you with the vote."

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: He put his hat back on.

172.speaker: Player
172.text: "It was nice to have you here, Mr. Garaci. I hope you'll reconsider your support."

173.speaker: Heron Garaci
173.text: "Thank you for inviting me here. It's a shame that we're leaving empty-handed, but it was a nice meeting."

174.speaker: Heron Garaci
174.text: "Goodbye, Mr. President. It was nice to talk to you."

176.speaker: Heron Garaci
176.text: "I am not your dog, Mr. Rayne."

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: He left me alone with my thoughts.

180.speaker: Player
180.text: "Thank you for coming, Mr. Garaci. It was a fruitful meeting."

182.speaker: Player
182.text: "I hope I can rely on you."

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: We shook hands and he left me alone with my thoughts.

192.speaker: Heron Garaci
192.text: "I want to help you, Mr. President."

193.speaker: Heron Garaci
193.text: "I can organize the justices to vote for your proposal."

209.speaker: Player
209.text: "Fine. I'm sure this would convince you. [-1 Personal Wealth]"

210.speaker: Heron Garaci
210.text: "If you can help me with some *investments,* I can be a valuable ally to have in the Supreme Court."

211.speaker: Heron Garaci
211.text: "And I will support you not only with the vote but afterwards."

215.speaker: Player
215.text: "I'm sorry, Mr. Garaci. I don't have anything to spare."

217.speaker: Heron Garaci
217.text: "I thought you were the one who asked for my help, Mr. President."

218.speaker: Heron Garaci
218.text: "I gave you my offer. If you don't like it, there will be no support from my end. Easy as that."

223.speaker: Heron Garaci
223.text: "I already have a reasonable support behind me."

227.speaker: Heron Garaci
227.text: "With the evidence I can provide, you can make a case to the Assembly to start his impeachment process."

228.speaker: Heron Garaci
228.text: "In such a circumstance, I'm pretty sure the members of the assembly would proceed with it. Mr. Hawker is not enjoying his old popularity anymore. We all know that."

229.speaker: Heron Garaci
229.text: "Well, yes. The new changes will allow the Grand National Assembly to impeach the justices. I thought your intention was to use that for your own interest."
